About us

Our Journey Since 1979

A commitment to expanding educational opportunities and supporting social development in rural Gujarat.

Bharuch Jilla Adarsh Samaj Seva Mandal was established with a commitment to expanding educational opportunities and supporting social development in rural Gujarat.

Over the years the organization has developed a network of schools, colleges, residential Ashramshalas, hostels and educational programmes serving communities in and around Narmada district. Our institutions aim to reduce barriers to education by bringing learning closer to rural and tribal communities.

Today our work extends beyond formal education into professional learning, nursing, vocational skills, environmental awareness, student welfare and community development.

Our Vision

To build an educated, empowered, skilled and self-reliant society in which every individual, particularly those from rural and tribal communities, has opportunities to learn, grow and improve their quality of life.

Our Mission

  • Promote accessible, quality education at different academic levels
  • Support tribal children through residential education and welfare
  • Strengthen higher, professional and nursing education
  • Expand vocational training and employment-oriented skills
  • Encourage women's education and youth empowerment
  • Promote environment, health awareness and community service
  • Build partnerships that improve education and livelihoods

🛠️ Narmada Skill Training Center (NSTC)

Our Vision: Every Youth Skilled. Every Skill Valued. Every Community Empowered.

Narmada Skill Training Center provides multisector vocational education, technical training and livelihood enhancement, with special emphasis on rural, tribal and economically disadvantaged youth in Narmada Aspirational District.

Narmada Skill Training Center · NSTC

Our Training Focus Areas

Comprehensive Skill Development for Employment, Self-Employment & Entrepreneurship

Narmada Skill Training Center (NSTC) provides a platform for multisector vocational education, technical training, professional skill development and livelihood enhancement, with special emphasis on rural, tribal and economically disadvantaged youth in Gujarat's Narmada Aspirational District.

NSTC aims to offer a wide range of industry-relevant, demand-driven and future-ready skill training programmes across various sectors, based on emerging employment opportunities, local economic needs, industry requirements and applicable government skill development frameworks.

Skill development

Key Areas of Skill Development

🔧

Technical & Vocational Skills

Practical, occupation-oriented training across technical, industrial and service sectors.

🤖

Digital & Emerging Technology Skills

Digital literacy, modern technologies, AI-enabled applications and future workforce competencies.

🩺

Healthcare & Allied Services

Employment-oriented vocational skills supporting healthcare and allied occupations.

🌾

Agriculture & Rural Livelihood Skills

Training that strengthens rural employment, traditional occupations and income-generating opportunities.

🏭

Manufacturing & Industrial Skills

Industry-focused competencies aligned with workforce requirements.

🧑‍💼

Service Sector & Professional Skills

Vocational training for diverse service industries and professional occupations.

👩

Women-Centric Skill Development

Inclusive training opportunities supporting women's employment, entrepreneurship and economic independence.

🚀

Entrepreneurship & Self-Employment

Business readiness, microenterprise development and sustainable livelihood skills.

📜

Recognition of Prior Learning (RPL)

Opportunities for experienced workers to obtain formal recognition of existing skills under applicable schemes.

🗣️

Soft Skills & Employability Development

Communication, workplace behaviour, financial literacy, career readiness and professional development.

Our Training Commitment

NSTC seeks to strengthen the connection between skill development, industry demand, employment, entrepreneurship and sustainable livelihoods.

Through partnerships with government departments, Sector Skill Councils, industries, employers, CSR organisations and training institutions, NSTC aims to expand access to quality vocational training and create meaningful economic opportunities.

Our activities

Learning Beyond the Classroom

We believe education should develop responsible citizens who contribute positively to society.

22 July 2025

Tree Plantation & Best Out of Waste

Students and staff of B.Ed., B.R.S. and M.S.W. Colleges planted trees at Mangrol, with discussions on environmental protection and a Best Out of Waste competition.

17 July 2025

Student Cultural Competitions

Mehndi, Rangoli, hairstyling, saree draping and other creative competitions encouraging expression and confidence.

1 August 2025

Nari Vandan Utsav

Jointly organized with the District Women and Child Officer's Office and Abhayam 181 Women Helpline: Beti Bachao awareness, prevention of female foeticide and a village rally.

August 2025

World Tribal Day & Raksha Bandhan

Celebrating tribal heritage, traditional songs, dances and cultural identity.

15 August 2025

Independence Day

Flag hoisting, patriotic addresses and student performances at Mangrol College Campus with students, teachers, trustees and the local community.

5 September 2025

Teachers' Day

Students and faculty recognised the importance of teachers in education and personal development.

2 October 2025

Gandhi Jayanti & Cleanliness Awareness

Ram Dhun, student engagement, environmental awareness and cleanliness activities in the campus and village.

18 November 2025

Nasha Mukt Bharat Abhiyaan

A pledge programme supporting a drug-free India and responsible social behaviour.

4–5 December 2025

Uttarvahini Narmada Cleanliness Drive

Students and staff cleaned areas near the Ranchhodraiji Temple at Rampura and Sitaram Ashram along the Parikrama route, with discussion on the significance of the Narmada River.

1 October 2026

Van Mahotsav

Shri Narmada College of Education, Mangrol, with the Social Forestry Range, Rajpipla: tree plantation and awareness with public representatives, forestry officials, educators and students.

🇮🇳

National Service & Institutional Support

BJAASM has provided temporary accommodation and campus facilities for personnel of the Border Security Force (BSF) and Central Industrial Security Force (CISF) during preparations for ceremonial events at the Statue of Unity, Ekta Nagar, reported at approximately 15 days annually over the past two years. This reflects our commitment to community cooperation and public service.

Impact & achievements

More Than Four Decades of Commitment

Since 1979, BJAASM has contributed to the educational and social-development landscape of Narmada district.

Our Institutional Contributions

  • Established a longstanding school education network
  • Developed residential educational support for tribal students
  • Established boys' and girls' hostel facilities
  • Expanded teacher education, rural studies and social work
  • Added nursing and healthcare-oriented education
  • Developed vocational training through NSTC
  • Ran student-development, environmental and awareness programmes
  • Supported national ceremonial activities through accommodation
